# Software Bill of Materials (SBOM)

## Overview

This chapter provides the Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) as required by CRA Annex I Part II(1): "Manufacturers shall identify and document vulnerabilities and components contained in the product, including by drawing up a software bill of materials in a commonly used and machine-readable format covering at least the top-level dependencies of the product."

**SBOM Format:** {{< meta sbom.format >}} (CycloneDX/SPDX)

**Generation Date:** [Date]  
**Product:** {{< meta product.name >}} v{{< meta product.version >}}

## SBOM Maintenance

### Update Frequency

The SBOM is updated:
- With each product release
- When components are added, removed, or updated
- When vulnerabilities are discovered in components

### SBOM Availability

The machine-readable SBOM is available:
- Embedded in the product distribution
- Via download from: [URL]
- Upon request from: {{< meta manufacturer.contact_email >}}

## Component Update Strategy

This SBOM fulfills the requirement of CRA Annex I Part II(1) for documenting components and dependencies in a commonly used and machine-readable format.
